title: Privacy choices
lead: You can read every article here without an account, and you can decide what little we remember about you.
body: We don't use advertising or cross-site tracking. We don't set any cookies, including via the analytics service named below.

We store only your reading-track preference (Everyday or Technical) in your browser, so articles automatically open in the version you last selected. The table below shows exactly what we store and where. See the privacy policy for more information about how we handle your data.
To reset what's stored, clear our site data in your browser settings, or switch tracks again to overwrite just the reading-track preference.

tables.caption: Local storage
rows: Remembers which reading track (Everyday or Technical) you last chose, so articles open in that version. Default: citizen.
A random ID assigned in your browser so it can distinguish visits without identifying you personally. Set by the analytics service named above, not by our own code.
